description:
✅ Fun-shaped stars & moons that make mornings exciting for every little astronaut.

🥣 Millet Choco Crunch - Start the day with a fun choco crunch!

❌ No Refined Sugar, only sweetened with Jaggery

💪 Multigrain Energy and Chocolatey

❌ No Maida | No Preservatives | No Refined Sugar | No Artificial Flavours

🌟 Step 1: Pour 200 ml of warm/cold milk into a bowl.
🌟 Step 2: Take 20 g Millet Choco Crunch Star & Moon to it.
🌟 Step 3: Mix a bit and enjoy the crunch.

For 2–3 year olds, please check with your nutritionist before serving.
